Car Towing Services in Calgary

WHAT WE OFFER

Wherever You’re Stuck, We’re Already on the Way

Auto Towing

Professional vehicle towing with modern flatbed trucks and wreckers. We handle cars, trucks, SUVs, and commercial vehicles across Calgary, Airdrie, Cochrane, Chestermere, and Okotoks. Safe transport, trained operators, and transparent pricing for every tow.

Flat Tire Change or Replacement

On-site mobile tire assistance anywhere in Calgary. We handle flat tire changes, patch repairs, and full replacements at your home, work, or roadside. Professional technicians arrive with all necessary tools. Fast, safe, and convenient.

Battery Boost & Jump Start

24/7 jump starts: even in extreme cold. Dead battery? We'll get you running in minutes. BP Towing Service provides rapid-response battery boosting across Calgary with heavy-duty equipment for cars, trucks, and SUVs. Available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, even during harsh winter conditions.

Cash for Junk Cars & Scrap Vehicles

Top cash paid: free removal. Turn your unwanted vehicle into instant cash. We buy junk cars, scrap vehicles, and damaged cars in any condition, running or not. Competitive offers, free towing, and hassle-free removal across Calgary. No hidden fees. No paperwork stress.

Emergency Fuel Delivery

Gas, diesel & premium: delivered to you. Ran out of gas? We bring fuel to your location. BP Towing Service delivers regular, premium, and diesel fuel directly to stranded vehicles across Calgary and surrounding areas. Fast response, clean delivery, and no need for a tow.

Winch-Out & Vehicle Recovery

Professional recovery from snow, mud & ditches. Stuck off-road or in a snowbank? Our recovery specialists use advanced winching equipment to safely extract vehicles from snow, mud, ice, and ditches, without causing damage. Reliable recovery for cars, trucks, and SUVs across Calgary.

Roadside Assistance

24/7 emergency roadside support across Calgary. Our mobile units arrive within 30 minutes for flat tire changes, battery jumps, fuel delivery, lockout assistance, and minor repairs. Professional equipment. Fast response. Reliable service when you need it most.

Local Hauling

Small-scale transport solutions for trailers, boats, ATVs, snowmobiles, and equipment. Reliable local hauling for homeowners, contractors, and businesses across Calgary. Proper securing equipment. Flexible scheduling. Transparent pricing.

Motorcycle Towing

Specialized motorcycle transport with damage-free guarantee. Our flatbed trucks feature motorcycle-specific wheel chocks and soft straps for secure transport. We handle cruisers, sport bikes, touring models, dirt bikes, and scooters across Calgary.
